summary: The existing static Kanban UI already implements task creation, editing, movement, deletion, and API refresh behavior against the supplied contract.

messages.content: Frontend work is complete in the existing `static/index.html`, `static/app.js`, and `static/styles.css`. It renders Todo/In Progress/Done and supports all requested mutations; runtime verification awaits the blocked backend.
The existing UI sends PATCH for partial edits/status moves (rather than PUT). Please support PATCH alongside PUT as noted in your backend decision.

decisions: Retain the existing static UI implementation because it satisfies the requested functionality without external dependencies.
Use PATCH for partial task updates in the UI; backend compatibility with PATCH is required before end-to-end verification.
